$comment: Synthetic cases for the as-of rule (review of 24 Nov 2026, Decision 6). One table for both implementations: the fake provider's test (tests/contracts/fidrec-update-contract.test.ts) and Lane 1's SQL test for the database functions run every case. Keys use the test. prefix so they never collide with a loaded document; each case says which real paragraph it stands for. Procedure: rule = the document's as_of_rule; readDate = generatedOn when rule is any_date, else eventDate; read the clause as of readDate (a verified version whose effective_from, or the clause's own start, is on or before readDate). No clause -> not_held. A clause from an any_date document whose version date (documentDate) is after eventDate -> held_after_the_events. Otherwise held.

The MAS reply of 13 January 2026, in a pack generated before the reply existed
The MAS reply of 7 January 2025, for a September 2025 event: printed, dated before the events
The MAS reply of 7 January 2025, for a 2024 event: printed whatever the event date, after the events
